On this small beans plot, I will keep costs low and use what I can manage with my household labor. Since beans are intercropped and the rains in Iringa are usually enough for the season, I will rely on manure if I have it, plant my usual seed, and do hand weeding instead of buying many inputs. I do not expect to irrigate, and I will not hire labor for such a small piece.
